title: Supportive Cancer Care Takes Center Stage as Members of the National Coalition Together for Supportive Cancer Care Ring the Nasdaq Closing Bell
author: Not Specified
description: Members of Together for Supportive Cancer Care, a national coalition of over 40 organizations, rang the Nasdaq closing bell on July 16, 2026, to promote Supportive Cancer Care as the national standard of care in the United States. The coalition advocates for comprehensive cancer care that addresses emotional, practical, and financial support alongside clinical treatment, with research showing it improves quality of life, outcomes, and reduces costs.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Nasdaq provided venue and platform for the coalition's awareness campaign but had no direct business involvement or impact from the event.

title: NPM Announces Acquisition of Nasdaq Fund Secondaries (NFS)
author: Na
description: Nasdaq Private Market (NPM), an independent spinoff from Nasdaq Inc., has announced the acquisition of Nasdaq's fund secondaries business. The deal, expected to close in Q3 2026, expands NPM's platform to handle both direct company shares and multi-asset fund stakes, positioning it to serve the full spectrum of private secondary liquidity demand. The private secondaries market reached record scale with $233 billion in global volume in 2025.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Nasdaq is divesting its fund secondaries business to a better-positioned independent entity while maintaining strategic investment and partnership, allowing the business to realize its full potential and demonstrating confidence in the private markets opportunity.

title: How to Invest in SpaceX Stock After Its Nasdaq-100 Debut
author: Leo Sun
description: SpaceX's stock has declined 17% since joining the Nasdaq-100 in July and fallen below its $135 IPO price, despite the index inclusion forcing ETF purchases. The stock peaked at $225.64 in mid-June but faces headwinds from high valuation multiples (87x revenue), unprofitability across segments, and upcoming share unlocks. While analysts project 97% revenue CAGR through 2028, investors should consider whether such bullish estimates are realistic before buying.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Stock has declined 17% since Nasdaq-100 inclusion and fallen below IPO price. Company is unprofitable with losses in space and AI segments offsetting Starlink profits. Valuation remains elevated at 87x revenue despite growth concerns. Upcoming 20% share unlock presents dilution risk.

Nasdaq is mentioned as the index operator that fast-tracked SpaceX's inclusion. No performance issues or concerns are attributed to Nasdaq itself; it is referenced neutrally as the exchange administrator.

title: 2 Reasons July 7 Is Shaping Up as a Monster Day for SpaceX
author: Sean Williams
description: SpaceX is poised for significant stock movement on July 7, 2026, due to two converging catalysts: eligibility for inclusion in the Nasdaq-100 index (which will trigger automatic buying from index funds) and the end of the 25-calendar-day quiet period for participating underwriters, allowing them to issue buy recommendations and price targets. However, the article cautions that this potential pop may be temporary, as insider share lockups will expire after the company's first quarterly earnings release in August.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Two major catalysts converging on July 7 are expected to drive significant buying pressure: mandatory index fund purchases following Nasdaq-100 eligibility and a wave of buy recommendations from underwriters. However, the positive sentiment is tempered by the acknowledgment that gains may be temporary due to upcoming insider share lockup expirations.

title: The Sneaky Way SpaceX, Anthropic, and OpenAI Can Destroy the Trump Bull Market
author: Sean Williams
description: Recently amended index inclusion rules allow SpaceX, Anthropic, and OpenAI to gain fast-track entry into major stock indexes. However, historical data shows that hyped tech IPOs experience average year-one drawdowns of 55%, and game-changing technologies typically face optimization challenges that could undermine the current Trump bull market.
